title: Successor cycles map exists
statement: With an abelian category C, a cochain complex K, a decreasing filtration F, r >= 1, page differential data D, a bidegree pq, and the inclusion hZ of graded successor cycles into graded r-cycles, the inclusion followed by the r-page quotient factors through the kernel of the outgoing page differential, with exactly the prescribed composite.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed cycle, boundary and differential formulas and lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-complex

proof.text: Put p = pq.1, n = pq.1 + pq.2 and j = (p+r,pq.2-r+1). Let a be the successor-cycle inclusion followed by the page quotient projection. The image factorization defining graded successor cycles gives an epimorphism from their unquotiented representatives onto them: adding F^(p+1) does not change this image because the graded projection kills F^(p+1). On these representatives, dx lies in F^(p+r+1). Regard dx as a representative in F^(p+r); its graded class is zero, so in D.on_representatives take the target graded cycle to be zero. This gives (a followed by D.d pq j) = 0 after the representative epimorphism, hence before it by cancellation. The kernel universal property, HomologicalComplex.liftCycles, now gives f with f followed by D.page.iCycles pq equal to a. No epimorphy claim about f is needed for this factorization.

theorem filteredComplex_successor_cycles_cover_exists
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (D : FilteredComplexPageDifferential K F r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hZ : F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) ≤
      F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) r) :
    ∃ f : (F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) : C) ⟶ D.page.cycles pq,
      f ≫ D.page.iCycles pq =
        Subobject.ofLE _ _ hZ ≫ filteredComplexPageπ K F r pq
